smell_definition: Groups of variables that are frequently passed together, suggesting poor encapsulation or missing class abstraction.

rule.definition: A set of at least 3 identical required positional parameter names (excluding self/cls, *args, **kwargs, keyword-only and defaulted parameters) that appears verbatim in at least 3 distinct function/method signatures of the production package. Every signature carrying the group is one violation.
